product_one_liner.value: Owl provides insurance-specific AI software that reads and analyzes claim files, automates document work, and surfaces cited insights to help insurers make faster, fairer claims decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: Company describes itself as an AI company for insurance claims and describes OwlVision/OwlAssist capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer lacks a pricing link; public site directs enterprise prospects to contact/book a discussion rather than giving public pricing.

named_customers.notes: Success-stories page and available case study did not disclose named customers; the case study refers only to a leading insurer. Partnership mentions are not treated as customer evidence.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company listing gives a 51–200 range; Built In lists approximately 80 employees, supporting the requested 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn and PitchBook identify Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company profile lists 2018 as year founded; company homepage says optimized for insurance since 2017, but this is not a stated company founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The resource index is a marketing/resource blog. No two posts by engineers about product architecture, infrastructure, model implementation, incidents, or open source were identified.

public_docs.notes: Homepage navigation and footer show product, company, and contact links but no public docs, developer portal, or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers page lists open titles but none is titled AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision. Technical role descriptions mentioning AI do not meet the title rule.

model_provider.value: Owl's proprietary/custom vision-language and domain-specific models; no external model provider is publicly identified.
model_provider.notes: The site refers to custom vision-language/domain-specific models and customer-isolated Owl models, and its privacy/security material reviewed did not identify an outside model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: These are expressly listed as assessed/compliance certifications. GDPR and CCPA are described as handling/privacy frameworks, not certifications; PCI DSS is not listed.

last_funding.notes: The dated funding announcement identifies a $30 million Series B announced November 3, 2021, and says it brought total funding to $40 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified funding round is the Series B in November 2021, well before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Account Executive role is listed on the company's careers page.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable press and resource indexes were reviewed; no dated product or major-feature launch announcement within 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09 was identified. Recent items are coverage or educational resources, not launch announcements.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full executive roster reviewed lists the current leadership team but no C-level or VP hire/joining within 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09; no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Enterprise Account Executive job description explicitly asks the role to forecast and maintain records in Salesforce.
